parameters.name: CustomFields
parameters.description: The list of custom field objects.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the account. The name can be up to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address. The prefix of the email address can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: EmailVerified
parameters.description: Specifies whether the email address is verified. This parameter is required if an email address is specified. If no special business requirements exist, set this parameter to true.

parameters.name: PhoneNumber
parameters.description: The phone number. The value must be 6 to 15 digits in length.

parameters.name: PhoneNumberVerified
parameters.description: Specifies whether the phone number is verified as a trusted phone number. This parameter is required if a phone number is specified. If no special business requirements exist, set this parameter to true.

parameters.name: PhoneRegion
parameters.description: The phone region code. Example: 86 for the Chinese mainland, without the 00 or + prefix. This parameter is required if a phone number is specified.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The account name. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), at signs (@), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 256 characters in length.
